#### 5. Cline #14309 Windows desktop signing token priming — NOT APPLICABLE (desktop CI/CD)

- **What**: Cline PR #14309 "fix(ci): prime the Trusted Signing token before the Windows desktop build" merged 2026-09-19 fixed Windows desktop build signing failures (problem: Sep 19 nightlies failed with `failed to run pwsh` ~2.5s into signing first binary, Tauri discards sign command stdout/stderr on non-zero exit so real error from `tauri-sign-windows.ps1` never reached log; root cause: Windows job logs into Azure with `azure/login` (GitHub OIDC), runs Rust build, Tauri invokes `tauri-sign-windows.ps1` once per binary calling `az account get-access-token --resource https://codesigning.azure.net`, first call asks for codesigning resource token so az must re-present GitHub OIDC assertion to Entra, Entra only accepts assertion for ~10 min (5 min lifetime + 5 min clock skew), login-to-first-sign gap was ~8.5 min before #14303 UPX compression added 2 min, pushing gap to ~10 min and exceeding assertion validity window; fix: add step right after `azure/login` that fetches codesigning token once, az caches it (MSAL token cache), later per-file calls served from cache without touching assertion, token lives >1h far longer than build, fails immediately with az's real error if token can't be acquired). This is desktop CI/CD bug fix (Azure Trusted Signing token acquisition timing, observability).

- **Why**: Desktop CI/CD bug fix. Alexi has no desktop app (CLI only), no Azure Trusted Signing, no Windows desktop build. NOT APPLICABLE to Alexi.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14309 (Cline Windows desktop signing token priming)

- **Category**: N/A (desktop CI/CD, not applicable)

- **Size**: SKIP. NOT APPLICABLE (desktop app CI/CD, Alexi is CLI only).
